R1_HOST.description: The IP address or hostname for device R1.

R2_HOST.description: The IP address or hostname for device R2.

DEMO_MODE.description: When set to true, the server returns realistic mock data instead of connecting to real devices.

NETBOX_URL.description: The URL of the NetBox server (e.g., http://localhost:8000).

USE_NETBOX.description: Set to true to pull device inventory from a NetBox instance.

NETBOX_TOKEN.description: The API token for authenticating with NetBox.

DEVICE_PASSWORD.description: The password used to authenticate with the network devices.

DEVICE_USERNAME.description: The username used to authenticate with the network devices.

MCP_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout for upstream requests in milliseconds.
